parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under both 'Examples/' and 'WallpaperSampleApp/' — canonical sample-app directory markers that trigger the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. Lifting the shared 'MetricRow.body' computed property from the production 'DebugPanel' package into a common location would couple production code to demonstration semantics carried by the WallpaperSampleApp copy. The duplication is intentional: the sample app maintains its own local DebugHUD for self-contained demonstration purposes, and the production copy in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' should evolve independently.
